notes: TheImdDaily (TID) is a plain OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with 18 decimals and no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints the fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 TID (1e27 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There is no further minting, no owner, no fees, burns, pauses or other privileged functions. The launch deploys no application contracts.
